method.planMonthly: Annual prices divided by 12, quarterly prices by 3, and weekly prices multiplied by 52/12. Rankings use regular prices.
method.apiBlended: Weights uncached input and output 3:1, in USD per million tokens.
method.value: Agentic Index ÷ USD cost per task. Models need an Agentic Index of at least 40.
method.excluded: Price highlights require at least partial verification. Model value requires a qualifying score and a positive task cost.
